source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design), broken out by self-reported party (party). Share answering "yes" to q311 ("do you think the American people as a whole are ready to elect a Mormon as president"); "other/depends" and don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
